description: Community-Led Resilience Program Leads to Shovel-Ready Projects is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by North Carolina Division of Coastal Management; North Carolina Sea Grant; North Carolina General Assembly. Learn how the North Carolina Division of Coastal Management is helping communities build their resilience to coastal flood hazards through an incentive-based program that provides planning and funding for nature-based projects. Coverage: North Carolina (2023). The toolkit gives North Carolina as the location, 2023 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
